sessions.phase_label: Preliminary review and chapter-based visual strategy engagement

requirements.title: Chapter Visual Strategy and Recommendations
requirements.definition: Provide a clear chapter-level strategy identifying which visuals should be kept, removed, moved, added, sourced, permission-cleared, or created, with placement rationale and recommendations, while excluding final design, formatting, sourcing, and graphic creation.
requirements.boundary_note: The preliminary review and subsequent chapter rounds apply the same visual-analysis behavior to different chapter scopes. Selection, placement, sourcing, permission, and creation recommendations are dimensions of one chapter visual strategy; manuscript placeholder insertion and tracker maintenance are separate deliverables.

requirements.title: Manuscript Visual Placeholders
requirements.definition: Insert usable visual placeholders into each assigned manuscript chapter to represent the recommended visual placements.
requirements.boundary_note: Placeholder insertion is an independently deliverable manuscript change. The reasoning behind placements belongs to the chapter visual-strategy Requirement, while tracker changes belong to the image-tracker Requirement.

requirements.title: Image Tracker Updates
requirements.definition: Update the image tracker for each assigned chapter round so it reflects the resulting visual plan and remaining visual needs.
requirements.boundary_note: Tracker maintenance is a separate artifact obligation that can be completed or evaluated independently from inserting manuscript placeholders and writing the chapter-level strategy.
